text:
I'm sorry your plant is struggling. Unfortunately, the standard guarantee is 30 days from delivery, and at 5 weeks (about 35 days) you're outside that window. Claims made after the window aren't covered, so I can't offer a free replacement.

A Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email, which may help save the plant. If you think there's a circumstance I should know about, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead for review, though I can't promise a different outcome.
